I can run the technical portion of the demo, but to make sure you get the commercial and rollout Q&A covered I'd like to propose two options:

1) Move to Mon 11/23 11:00 AM PT — full team (Marissa + Rishi) will be back and we can cover pricing/rollout thoroughly.

2) Keep 11/17/11/18 window and have Marissa record a short pricing segment separately; I will run the live demo and we can do a follow-up 20-min sync the week of 11/30 for procurement items.

Which would you prefer? If option 1 works I'll send a calendar invite (Attachment: calendar-invite.ics).

Thanks,
